headline: Committee discusses West Maui plan and water limits on housing

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster, Resilience, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.summary: The committee discussed West Maui Community Plan updates after the 2023 wildfires, heard how water limits housing, and deferred the draft resolution.
meeting.recap: The only item was a draft resolution seeking West Maui Community Plan updates that match infrastructure plans after the August 2023 wildfires.[[0:05:34]] The chair said the goal was to start a discussion, not pass the resolution.[[0:06:53]] One testifier asked the County to consider phasing out water and sewer service in hazard-prone areas.[[0:26:54]] The draft long-term recovery plan will go to community open houses later in October.[[1:09:20]] A state water commission official said existing users will likely be handled before new users.[[1:19:13]] The official said the commission hopes to get moving on water use permits next year.[[1:20:04]] The director said the department has approved every temporary housing water request so far.[[2:14:00]] Asked if that means saying no to a permanent housing project for three years, the answer was "Yes, that's correct.".[[2:17:41]] The committee deferred (put off) the item without objection.[[2:23:15]]
meeting.next: The chair said discussion of the resolution may continue into future meetings if needed. The Planning Department said it would bring any needed community plan revisions to the Maui Planning Commission and the County Council. The chair said she has a meeting scheduled with the Hawaiʻi Community Foundation.

moments.q: "What is holding them back from moving forward is water."
Planning: community plan amendments would be premature
Permanent housing may wait three years for water: "Yes, that's correct."

issues.oneLine: The County is approving water for temporary housing, expecting it to phase out as permanent homes return.
issues.why: The chair said West Maui desperately needs permanent housing.
issues.next: Temporary projects that want to become permanent must apply again as new permanent requests.
issues.brief: A county engineering manager said temporary permits under a new ordinance last a maximum of five years.[[#1]]
